_meta.title: Session 35 — Resolve stale monitoring TODOs: Video-MME + MMAU frontier backfill
_meta.context: Re-investigation of the 'Watch for future publications' cc:TODO list in Plans.md (last checked 2026-05-08, ~3 weeks stale). Four items re-swept via parallel research + direct source verification. RESULT: only Video-MME + MMAU yielded ingestible frontier data. Official leaderboards (video-mme.github.io, sakshi113.github.io/mmau_homepage) are STILL stale (latest entries 2025-09 / May-2025), but two 2026 primary-source technical reports now carry frontier numbers: (1) Qwen3.5-Omni Technical Report (arxiv 2604.15804, Qwen Team, 2026-04-17) and (2) Step-Audio-R1.5 Technical Report (arxiv 2604.25719, StepFun / Yuxin Zhang et al, 2026-04-28). This is the FIRST MMAU coverage (was 0 scores) and the first 2026-frontier Video-MME additions. Other three TODO items remain blocked (see notes) — dates refreshed in Plans.md.
_meta.rule: STRICT-ATTRIBUTION. Every score has model+benchmark+value appearing together in one primary-source table, verified by direct WebFetch of the arxiv HTML (not agent-relayed). First-party reports win on conflict: Qwen3.5-Omni MMAU uses Qwen's own Table 5 (Plus 82.2 / Flash 80.4), NOT StepFun's lower comparison figures (Plus 79.6 / Flash 77.2) — discrepancy noted, likely different eval protocol. Gemini values are third-party comparison numbers (reported by Qwen/StepFun in their own tables) — admitted under the same practice used in Session 19 (cross-model comparison-table backfill), each flagged as reported-by-X. video_mme_audio is split from video_mme because it is a distinct protocol (use_audio_in_video=True, audiovisual->text) that scores materially higher than vision-only Video-MME and must not share the standard column.

models.name: Step-Audio-R1.5
models._note: StepFun audio-reasoning model, successor to Step-Audio-R1 / R1.1. Technical report arxiv 2604.25719 (Yuxin Zhang et al, 18 co-authors). MMAU 77.9 (self-reported), trails Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus 82.2 and Gemini-3.1 Pro 81.1 on audio understanding.

benchmarks.name: Video-MME (with audio)
benchmarks.description: Video-MME evaluated in audiovisual->text mode with use_audio_in_video=True — the audio track is provided alongside sampled frames. Distinct, materially-higher-scoring protocol vs the standard vision-only Video-MME (w/o subtitles) column. Higher = better accuracy.
